The region remains on edge over possible renewed U.S. military operations against Iran. Talks continue, with Israel pressing for more strikes and other American allies urging restraint. Recent strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz have raised questions about Washington’s next steps. The strategic waterway has seen repeated attacks since the conflict began.

articles.title: From ‘Greatest Comeback’ To Midterm Setback: 3 Reasons Why Americans Lost Faith In Trump
articles.description: Trump failed to broker an end to the Russia-Ukraine war and eventually took the US into a direct military conflict with Iran, alongside Israel, its close ally in the region.

articles.title: From Iran to trade, how the US midterms impact the rest of the world
articles.description: US Democrats' recent midterm election victories could influence global relations, especially concerning Iran and Israel. The potential for a peace deal with Iran seems viable as US voters oppose prolonged conflicts. In Ukraine, Democrats may propose increased financial and military aid, which could face delays. Additionally, Asian countries may reconsider investment pledges to avoid tariffs in light of these outcomes.

articles.title: US midterm results: Here's what they could mean for Iran, Ukraine, oil prices and global relations
articles.description: Democrats’ midterm victories could complicate Trump’s policies on Iran, Israel, Ukraine, trade and artificial intelligence.
